name: Blip
install:
set -euo pipefail

# The image Go is older than go.mod. A golangci-lint built with it refuses this module.

GO_VERSION="$(sed -n 's/^go \([0-9.]*\)$/\1/p' go.mod)"
# Only the version: under the golangci-lint-action step, not any other version: line.
GL_VERSION="$(awk '/uses: golangci\/golangci-lint-action@/ {f=1; next} f && /^[[:space:]]*-[[:space:]]/ {f=0} f && /^[[:space:]]*version:[[:space:]]*v[0-9]/ {v=$0; sub(/.*version:[[:space:]]*v/, "", v); sub(/[^0-9.].*/, "", v); print v}' .github/workflows/ci.yml)"
GV_VERSION="$(sed -n 's/.*govulncheck@v\([0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' .github/workflows/ci.yml)"
set -- $GL_VERSION
if [ "$#" -ne 1 ] || [ -z "${1:-}" ]; then
  echo "expected one golangci-lint version in ci.yml, got: ${GL_VERSION:-<empty>}" >&2
  exit 1
fi
GL_VERSION=$1
set -- $GV_VERSION
if [ "$#" -ne 1 ] || [ -z "${1:-}" ]; then
  echo "expected one govulncheck version in ci.yml, got: ${GV_VERSION:-<empty>}" >&2
  exit 1
fi
GV_VERSION=$1
if [ -z "$GO_VERSION" ]; then
  echo "go.mod has no go version line" >&2
  exit 1
fi

pkgs=()
command -v gcc >/dev/null 2>&1 || pkgs+=(gcc libc6-dev)
command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || pkgs+=(curl ca-certificates)
command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || pkgs+=(python3)
command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 || pkgs+=(git)
if [ "${#pkgs[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then
  sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update
  sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends "${pkgs[@]}"
fi

case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64) goarch=amd64 ;;
  aarch64|arm64) goarch=arm64 ;;
  *) echo "unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

install_go=1
if [ -x /usr/local/go/bin/go ]; then
  have="$(GOTOOLCHAIN=local /usr/local/go/bin/go env GOVERSION 2>/dev/null || true)"
  if [ "$have" = "go${GO_VERSION}" ]; then
    install_go=0
  fi
fi
if [ "$install_go" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "installing Go ${GO_VERSION} (${goarch})"
  tarball="go${GO_VERSION}.linux-${goarch}.tar.gz"
  sha="$(python3 - "$GO_VERSION" "$goarch" <<'PY'
import json, sys, urllib.request
version, arch = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
filename = f"go{version}.linux-{arch}.tar.gz"
with urllib.request.urlopen("https://go.dev/dl/?mode=json") as resp:
    releases = json.load(resp)
for rel in releases:
    if rel.get("version") != f"go{version}":
        continue
    for item in rel.get("files", []):
        if item.get("filename") == filename:
            print(item["sha256"])
            raise SystemExit(0)
raise SystemExit(f"no checksum published for {filename}")
PY
)"
  tmp="$(mktemp)"
  curl -fsSL "https://go.dev/dl/${tarball}" -o "$tmp"
  echo "${sha}  ${tmp}" | sha256sum -c -
  sudo rm -rf /usr/local/go
  sudo tar -C /usr/local -xzf "$tmp"
  rm -f "$tmp"
else
  echo "Go ${GO_VERSION} already installed"
fi
sudo ln -sfn /usr/local/go/bin/go /usr/local/bin/go
sudo ln -sfn /usr/local/go/bin/gofmt /usr/local/bin/gofmt
export PATH="/usr/local/go/bin:${PATH}"
hash -r

GOBIN="$(go env GOPATH)/bin"
mkdir -p "$GOBIN"
GL="${GOBIN}/golangci-lint"
gl_ver="$("$GL" version 2>/dev/null || true)"
if printf '%s\n' "$gl_ver" | grep -q "version ${GL_VERSION} " && printf '%s\n' "$gl_ver" | grep -q "built with go${GO_VERSION}"; then
  echo "golangci-lint ${GL_VERSION} already installed"
else
  echo "installing golangci-lint v${GL_VERSION}"
  go install "github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2/cmd/golangci-lint@v${GL_VERSION}"
fi
sudo ln -sfn "$GL" /usr/local/bin/golangci-lint

GV="${GOBIN}/govulncheck"
if [ -x "$GV" ] && go version -m "$GV" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "golang.org/x/vuln[[:space:]]v${GV_VERSION}"; then
  echo "govulncheck ${GV_VERSION} already installed"
else
  echo "installing govulncheck v${GV_VERSION}"
  go install "golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@v${GV_VERSION}"
fi
sudo ln -sfn "$GV" /usr/local/bin/govulncheck

go mod download
echo "install complete: $(go env GOVERSION) golangci-lint ${GL_VERSION} govulncheck ${GV_VERSION}"
